source: Manually reviewed from the Atelier harness output for the North Studio invoice prompt. Synthetic data; no third-party brand assets.

tokens.display: Iowan Old Style, Palatino, Palatino Linotype, Georgia, serif

components.name: Centered page shell
rules: Use the page shell for every screen. The summary must never touch the viewport edge.
Use 48px gutters at 1280 and 24px at 390. Keep the content centered.

components.name: Brand and review line
components.html:
Payments console

rules: Keep the brand small and the review state quiet.
Do not add a logo badge, icon or navigation to an invoice task.

components.name: Invoice document
components.html:

Invoice 0042

rules: Use one white document, 14px radius, 1px border and one soft shadow.
The amount is the hero; the invoice number is a reference, not the page title.

components.html:

rules: The amount is the largest element on the screen.
Use display serif and tabular numerals. Do not repeat the total in a second card.

components.css: .summary{min-width:0}.facts{margin:24px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.facts div{display:grid;grid-template-columns:120px minmax(0,1fr);gap:16px;padding:12px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.facts div:last-child{border-bottom:0}.facts dt{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px}.facts dd{margin:0;text-align:right;font-size:14px}.consequence{margin:0 0 20px;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;line-height:1.55}.secondary{display:inline-flex;min-height:44px;align-items:center;margin-top:8px;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px}@media(max-width:760px){.facts div{grid-template-columns:96px minmax(0,1fr)}.facts dd{text-align:left}}
rules: Show supplier, amount, due date, source account, destination and consequence once.
Keep exactly one enabled primary action. The secondary recovery is a quiet text link.
Do not add checklists, AI summaries, status pills or a second primary button.

components.name: Primary action
rules: Use one filled primary action per screen.
It must be enabled and visible in the first 1280 by 800 view.
Use a quiet text link for recovery, not a second filled button.

components.css: .items{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;margin:24px 0;font-size:14px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.items th{padding:0 0 8px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.06em;text-align:left;text-transform:uppercase}.items td{padding:14px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.items th:first-child,.items td:first-child{width:52%}.items th:not(:first-child),.items td:not(:first-child){text-align:right}
rules: Use the supplied line items exactly; do not invent extra items, discounts or fees.
Keep the total visible. Do not repeat the total in another card.

components.name: Label and muted text
rules: Use labels for orientation, not as repeated headings.
Keep body copy at 14px and labels at 11px; at most six type sizes.

components.name: Quiet status pill
rules: Use at most one status pill.
Pair color with text. Do not use a pill for the primary action.
